changelog:
Initial release of work-productivity-tavily-web-workflow-helper.

- Provides practical support for Tavily-style web search workflows on Clawhub, including bug fixes, setup hardening, and improved reliability.
- Follows a clear workflow: restate user goals, outline a work plan, minimize manual steps, and validate outputs.
- Emphasizes reusable checklists, locally runnable artifacts, and actionable verification notes.
- Responds to validated, high-demand use cases with proven techniques and decision support for skill authors and advanced users.
- Triggered by keywords related to Tavily, web search, productivity, bugs, and workflow improvement.
